text_block_list.text: —The day of the Japan Cup.
(Rumble, rumble, rumble...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Wh-What is this rumbling?! An earthquake?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: No, that's not it... Is the air vibrating?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: —!? Someone's descending from the sky!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, fufufufu, bwa-ha-ha-ha! I'll grow 
one size—no, five hundred sizes bigger!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O descends upon us now!!! 
Behold, world! This is the "Overlord"—!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooooooooooh...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, good work operating the 
crane. Now, to the paddock.
(Rumble, rumble, rumble...!)

T.M. Opera O's sheer intensity had clearly 
grown even further.

As soon as we reached the paddock, a 
terrifying aura enveloped the venue. 
Amidst all that...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san is amazing... and so cool... I 
feel like I could never stand a chance...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Still, I have to do my best. I need to 
give it my all and run a good race...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: And so... what will you do next?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Will you become Opera O-san's lifelong 
rival? Or perhaps...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto. My old friend. Well? Have you 
resolved your feelings?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As my lifelong rival, will you style 
yourself the "Dark Overlord of Doto" to 
match the "Conqueror of the Century's 
End"?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: The Dark... Lord of Raging Waves...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That is... something we don't know yet. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'll understand if I run with 
Opera O-san today!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Because this feels like the real Opera O!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, indeed. I have finally reached the 
summit. The ultimate, perfected form of 
beauty.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Very well. In that case, let us hear how 
you feel once more after the race.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us begin. In our next battle— the 
heroes of the previous generation await at 
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Today is the eve of the festival! Let us 
make it a grand spectacle and welcome our 
guests from all over the world!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!
